A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DICE study. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support comparison, including material relocated or renumbered in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original dataset annotations, zero-shot and one-shot evaluations of 13 models, and frequency/performance and likelihood/performance analyses, including appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original annotation and model-evaluation results in Sections 3–5, Table 2, and the supplementary regression plots in Appendix H.

M1.justification: GPT-4 sentence generation, expert filtering, matching literal and figurative examples, and idiomaticity classification remain unchanged. Expanded procedural explanations do not introduce a new method or model component.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same English DICE coverage: 2,066 sentences, 402 expressions, and literal/figurative uses of phrasal idioms and noun compounds. The additional annotations are retained. IdioTS is added to related work, not evaluated.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same 13 GPT, Flan-T5, and Llama models, including the separately displayed sentence generator GPT-4. The supplementary analyses retain their model membership.

E3.justification: v1 Appendix E.2 says the few-shot example is appended to the prompt; v2 Section 4.1 and Table 5 prepend it. This changes the stated protocol, although the PDFs do not establish a rerun. Evaluation metrics, model configurations, and listed generation hyperparameters otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The descriptive frequency-distribution analysis is revised, and the 20-idiom pilot annotation-agreement check is no longer reported. The prompt-variation comparisons and model frequency/likelihood regressions remain, including the supplementary analyses moved from Appendix F to H.

E5.justification: Both report means and standard deviations across three prompt variants and retain the main annotation-agreement statistic, Cohen's kappa 0.95. No new repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing practice is documented; the omitted pilot point estimate is a results removal.

E6.justification: Table 2 scores and fitted regression lines are unchanged. However, the frequency histogram reports different counts without explaining the counting change, Figure 6 corrects the Llama 2/Llama 3.1 panel attribution, and the pilot kappa of 0.987 disappears. Results prose also corrects blanket one-shot improvement and consistent frequency-correlation statements.

T1.justification: The consistency criteria remain mathematically equivalent. Added accuracy equations and Appendix G's standard cross-entropy/log-likelihood identities explain existing measures; they introduce no new theoretical assumptions, substantive derivation, or formal result.

C1.justification: The DICE contribution and central claim that models struggle with contextual idiomaticity remain. Section 6 narrows the likelihood/performance claim to an association inconsistent across models and replaces the frequency-aids-recall assertion with a qualified, setting-dependent association.

C2.justification: The explanation for one-shot failures shifts from instruction tuning and prompt formatting to literal examples conflicting with model expectations. v2 also revises the frequency-bias explanation, qualifies the connection between likelihood and understanding, and adds the limitation that its frequency query misses syntactically flexible realizations.

D1.justification: Appendices E–G add exact GPT snapshot identifiers, SketchEngine/CQL frequency-query instructions using NLTK, and sentence-likelihood computation details. The consolidated prompt table omits v1's model-specific formatting instructions. Hardware, listed hyperparameters, and public code/data access remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references covering IdioTS, syntactic flexibility, idiom frequency and familiarity, and NLTK, including De Luca Fornaciari et al., Fazly et al., and Bird and Loper. These strengthen background support while retaining DICE's controlled contrastive positioning.

P1.justification: The abstract and substantial portions of the introduction, related work, results discussion, and conclusion are rewritten. Related-work topics and results subsections are reorganized, metric explanations expand, and the appendices are restructured. The standalone Ethical Considerations section is removed.

P2.justification: v2 consolidates prompts into Table 5, explicitly labels Table 2's zero-shot and one-shot panels, redraws the histogram, and adjusts regression-plot typography and ticks. Figures are relocated and renumbered, and Figure 6's caption is corrected; the regression displays retain their underlying results.

improvement.justification: Corrected model attribution in Figure 6, more accurate qualifications of the findings, and explicit model-version and frequency-query details improve clarity and reproducibility. These gains are limited by omitted model-specific prompt, pilot, and ethics documentation, plus unexplained prompt-order and histogram-count changes. Overall, v2 offers a modest improvement in reporting quality.
